out.title: ITC Infotech to acquire 22.1% of Happiest Minds and merge it
out.summary: ITC Infotech will buy 22.106% of Happiest Minds from promoter Ashok Soota for ~Rs 1,330 crore cash, then amalgamate HMTL into ITC Infotech; ITC Infotech shares to be listed. Completion in 3–8 months pending approvals.
